players.note: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Thursday that Robinson (ankle) has an "outside chance" to return from injured reserve for the 49ers' Week 7 game versus the Falcons but is more likely to be activated following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

players.name: Alec Ingold
players.note: The Chargers placed Ingold on injured reserve Thursday due to a shoulder injury.

players.name: Tyrod Taylor
players.note: Taylor played the final two snaps of Sunday's 31-7 win over the Bears, losing two yards on a pair of kneeldowns.

players.name: Ko Kieft
players.note: Kieft (elbow) does not carry an injury designation into Thursday's game against the Cowboys, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

players.name: Tyler Huntley
players.note: Huntley completed 19 of 31 passes for 165 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and added five rushes for 28 yards in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

players.name: Carsen Ryan
players.note: Ryan (calf) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Ravens.

players.name: Reggie Virgil
players.note: Virgil recorded two receptions for 29 yards on five targets in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Lions.

players.name: Braxton Berrios
players.note: Berrios (foot) underwent successful surgery Friday to repair a Lisfranc injury, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Skyy Moore
players.note: The Packers placed Moore (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Christian Kirk
players.note: The 49ers downgraded Kirk (calf) to out for Monday's game against the Commanders, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

players.name: Andy Dalton
players.note: Dalton agreed to a one-year contract with the Falcons on Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: David Sills V
players.note: Sills (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

players.name: Grant Calcaterra
players.note: The Eagles downgraded Calcaterra (back) to out Saturday for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

players.name: Roschon Johnson
players.note: Johnson rushed 13 times for 51 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-23 win over the Falcons. He caught both of his targets for 34 yards.

players.name: Aidan O'Connell
players.note: O'Connell (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Raiders' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Sunday.

players.name: Audric Estime
players.note: The Browns signed Estime to the 53-man roster Tuesday.

players.name: David Martin-Robinson
players.note: Martin-Robinson (hamstring) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts.

players.name: Jared Wayne
players.note: Wayne was claimed off waivers by the Dolphins on Tuesday.

players.name: Carter Runyon
players.note: Runyon (lower body) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Bills, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jackson Meeks
players.note: Meeks (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Arizona.

players.name: Coleman Owen
players.note: The Packers elevated Owen from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

players.name: Justin Joly
players.note: questionable

players.name: Cole Payton
players.note: Payton is active as the backup to starting quarterback Tanner McKee in Sunday's game against the Panthers.

players.name: Nick Vannett
players.note: Vannett (knee) practiced in full Thursday.

players.name: Justin Watson
players.note: The Chiefs elevated Watson from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Chargers, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

players.name: Easton Stick
players.note: The Bucs have elevated Stick from the practice squad ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

players.name: Zach Ertz
players.note: Ertz is not being elevated from the practice squad for Sunday's matchup against Carolina, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Tanner Hudson

players.name: Pharaoh Brown
players.note: Brown was signed to the 53-man roster Tuesday.

players.name: Tom Kennedy
players.note: The Lions placed Kennedy (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Van Jefferson
players.note: Jefferson reverted to the Commanders' practice squad Monday.

players.name: Brandon Johnson
players.note: The Steelers have elevated Johnson from the practice squad ahead of Sunday's game against the Bucs.

players.name: Cedric Tillman
players.note: The Saints elevated Tillman from the practice squad Saturday.

players.name: Evan Hull
players.note: The Cardinals elevated Hull from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Rams.

players.name: Lew Nichols
players.note: The Steelers signed Nichols off their practice squad Saturday.
